text: おうごんに　かがやく　たいもうと　９ほんの　ながい　しっぽを　もつ。

structure.jp: おうごんに　かがやく　たいもうと
９ほんの　ながい　しっぽを

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おうごんに　かがやく　たいもう
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing tells you which thing it is. おうごんに　かがやく　たいもう = 'fur that shines gold'.

patterns.name: 〜に (in what way)
patterns.span: おうごんに　かがやく
patterns.explanation: に after a colour or quality word says in what way the action shows itself. おうごんに　かがやく = 'shines in gold'.
